endpoints.description: Walks the configured root and returns one entry per flow/flow.json with id, path, language, and schema version.
Returns the typed flow plus the latest verification status.
Returns API readiness plus dependency status (also mounted at /api/v1/health for client callers).
Returns persisted verification history with optional flowId filter and a configurable limit.
Returns one verification run including the counterexample blob on failure.
Returns the local principal's persisted UI/CLI preferences. Hard-coded defaults are returned when no row exists; never 404s.
Partial-update of the local principal's preferences. Body is merged with the current row; unknown enum values produce 400.
Kicks off pipeline (discover → compile → artifact → codegen → lint) for one or all flows under the given root and returns a runId.
Returns status + result for one verification run.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: flows list
cli_commands.description: List every discovered flow under the configured root

cli_commands.name: flows explain
cli_commands.description: Print the typed flow plus its latest verification status

cli_commands.name: verify run
cli_commands.description: Regenerate verification artifacts for every flow

cli_commands.name: runs show
cli_commands.description: Show one verification run (with counterexample on failure)

cli_commands.name: settings get
cli_commands.description: Print the local principal's UI/CLI preferences

cli_commands.name: settings set
cli_commands.description: Update one or more UI/CLI preferences (key=value pairs)
